title: Carrer Of General Chang Chun, The New Minister For Foreign Affairs

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
〔右上角印章及手写编号：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. S.B. REGISTER / B. D. 3032 / Special Branch Station, / 13-12-35〕
Date ____ December 14. 1935

Subject ____ Career of General Chang Chun, the new Minister for Foreign Affairs.

Made by ________ and ____________________ Forwarded by ____ Supt. Tan Shao Liang.

General Chang Chun, the new Minister for Foreign
Affairs, received his education in Japan and speaks Japanese.
He was a fellow colleague of General Chiang Kai-shek when the
latter served under General Chen Chi Mei in Shanghai during
the Yuan Shih Kai regime. He is regarded as a trusted follower
of Chiang's Clique and pro-Japanese. His appointment as
Minister for Foreign Affairs as well as the appointment of
General Chiang Tso Ping(ex-Chinese Ambassador to Japan) as
Minister of Interior clearly indicates the present policy of
the Nanking Government.

During his tenure of office as Mayor of Shanghai
from 1929 to 1931, General Chang Chun was very energetic and
enthusiastic over measures aiming at the development of Chinese
territory. It was he who planned the establishment of the
Civic Centre in Kiangwan, the construction of a wharf at
Wan Tsao Pang to enable ships of large tonnage to unload cargo
and the proposed removal of the Railway Station from Paoshan
Road to Kiangwan which would do great harm to the prosperity
of the Settlement.

It was General Chang Chun who obstructed the plans
of the S.M.C. to construct or repair the roads outside limits
and it was he who initiated interference with Municipal Police
rights by establishing sub-stations and detailing patrols on
outside roads.

His chief secretary, Col. Yuan Liang, was appointed
Chief of Police and both were at one time bitterly hostile to
the Settlement Authorities.

Chang Chun's ambition to develop Kiangwan was checked
owing to financial difficulties and to troubles with Japanese.

〔左下角圆形印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / 14 DEC. 1935 / CHANCHUN〕

机密
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
〔右上角印章及手写编号：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 档案号 S.B. REGISTER / B. D. 3032 / 特务科分署，/ 1935年12月13日〕
日期 ____ 1935年12月14日

主题 ____ 新任外交部长张群将军的履历。

制作人 ________ 及 ___ 转呈人 ____ 谭绍良警司。

新任外交部长张群将军在日本接受教育，通晓日语。在袁世凯执政时期，蒋介石将军在上海陈其美将军麾下任职时，张群曾是蒋的同僚。他被视为蒋介石派系的亲信，且亲日。他出任外交部长，以及蒋作宾将军（前中国驻日大使）出任内政部长，清楚地表明了南京政府目前的政策。

在1929年至1931年担任上海市长期间，张群将军在旨在发展华界地区的措施上表现得非常积极和热情。正是他规划了在江湾建立市中心，在蕴藻浜修建码头以便大型吨位船舶卸货，并提议将火车站从宝山路迁至江湾，这将对租界的繁荣造成巨大损害。

正是张群将军阻碍了工部局在界外修筑或维修道路的计划，也是他通过设立分署并在界外道路部署巡逻警力，开始干涉工部局警务处的权利。

他的首席秘书袁良上校被任命为警察局长，两人当时都与租界当局势同水火。

由于财政困难以及与日本人的纠纷，张群开发江湾的野心受到了遏制。

〔左下角圆形印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1935年12月14日 / 张群〕

Date....................19

Subject....................................................................................................

Made by........................................................Forwarded by....................................................

Chang Chun's departure from Shanghai was thought to
have been due to an act of treachery towards Col. Chen Hsi-tseng,
the Chief of Police in 1931. The latter had received a secret
order from Chang Chun to arrest and kidnap student demonstrators
at a meeting at the West Gate. This was done but when the
pressure of the students became too great for him, General
Chang Chun revealed the place to which the captive students
had been taken and placed the whole blame on Col. Chen. The
removal of Col. Chen from office was a sequel to this incident.

Tandeanlang
Superintendent.

D. C. (Special Branch)

Acting Commissioner of Police,
Sir,
Information. Copies have been
sent with your compliments to Secretary-General
and Secretary.
JMcInnes

Please prepare short
comment on the other persons
holding prominent positions in
the new Cabinet.
JMS

人们认为，张群离开上海是由于他在1931年对警察局长陈希曾上校背信弃义所致。后者曾收到张群的密令，要在西门的一次会议上逮捕并绑架示威学生。此事虽已照办，但当学生施加的压力过大令他难以承受时，张群将军透露了被俘学生被关押的地点，并将全部责任推给陈上校。陈上校被免职便是这一事件的后继结果。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Friday, December 13, 1935

Japanese Interest
In China Cabinet

Five Returned Students
From Nippon Appear
In Appointments

Local Japanese official spokesmen today were rather non-committal on the new cabinet appointed by the Central Political Council, but appeared pleased that five out of the nine members were Japanese returned students.
“A Japanese returned student,” said a spokesman of the Japanese Embassy, “is not necessarily more friendly to Japan than a Chinese educated elsewhere, but he should understand our country better and thus be in a position to formulate policies on the basis of realities.

Japan’s Rapid Changes
“There is, however, some danger that Japanese returned students of the older generation may not be well posted on present-day Japan. Japan has changed tremendously during the past decade, and even during the past five years, and anyone who thinks today in terms of Japanese conditions of several years ago will fall into many errors.
“Japanese returned students, of course, have an excellent foundation to keep abreast of the changes in Japan, and some in the present cabinet have been in very close touch with Japan in recent years.”

Five In Cabinet
The Japanese returned students in the cabinet are: General Chang Chun, Minister of Foreign Affairs; General Chiang Tso-pin, Minister of the Interior; Mr. Chang Kung-chang, Minister of Railways; Mr. Wu Ting-chang, Minister of Industry; and General Ho Ying-ching, Minister of War. General Chiang Kai-shek, president of the Executive Yuan, is also a Japanese returned student.
General Chiang Tso-pin has been Chinese Minister and Ambassador to Japan for many years. Mr. Chang Kung-chang has visited Japan frequently during recent years while Governor of the Bank of China. Mr. Wu headed the recent Chinese Economic Mission to Japan.

The Others
Of the non-Japanese returned students in the cabinet, Dr. H. H. Kung, Minister of Finance, is an American returned student; Mr. Ku Meng-yu, Minister of Communications, is a German returned student; Dr. Wang Shih-chieh, Minister of Education, is a French returned student; and Admiral Chen Shao-kuan, Minister of Navy, is an English returned student.
Editorialising on the recent political developments in Nanking, the Japanese Shanghai Mainichi today voiced surprise at the ability of General Chiang Kai-shek to bring to a successful conclusion the sixth plenary session of the C.E.C., the fifth plenary session of the Kuomintang, the first session of the new C.E.C., and the monetary reforms in less than 40 days.

Soong Influence Felt
Mr. T. V. Soong, member of the Political Council, will maintain his influence in the administration through Dr. Kung, the paper predicted.
“The composition of the new Government,” the Mainichi concluded “favors positive action on the part of General Chiang. If the new government and party machinery fails to overcome the present difficulties, it is doomed to failure.”

（批：Reg.
Please attach to report by Mr Ian on General Chang Chun, Minister for Foreign Affairs and entered endless.
JAS）

《上海晚邮报与信使报》，1935年12月13日，星期五

日本对中国内阁的兴趣

五名留日学生
出现在任命名单中

当地日本官方发言人今天对中央政治委员会任命的新内阁态度较为保留，但对九名成员中有五人是留日学生表示满意。
日本大使馆的一位发言人称：“留日学生不一定比在其他地方受过教育的中国人更亲日，但他应该更了解我国，从而能够基于现实制定政策。”

日本的快速变化
“然而，存在一种危险，即老一代的留日学生可能不了解当今的日本。日本在过去十年，甚至过去五年中发生了巨大变化，任何今天仍以几年前的日本状况来思考的人都会犯下许多错误。”
“当然，留日学生拥有良好的基础以跟上日本的变化，目前内阁中的某些人近年来与日本保持着非常密切的联系。”

内阁中的五人
内阁中的留日学生包括：外交部长张群将军；内政部长蒋作宾将军；铁道部长张公权先生；实业部长吴鼎昌先生；以及军政部长何应钦将军。行政院院长蒋介石将军也是一名留日学生。
蒋作宾将军多年来一直担任中国驻日公使和大使。张公权先生在近年担任中国银行行长期间频繁访问日本。吴先生率领了最近的中国赴日经济代表团。

其他人
内阁中非留日学生的成员包括：财政部长孔祥熙博士是留美学生；交通部长顾孟余先生是留德学生；教育部长王世杰博士是留法学生；海军部长陈绍宽海军少将是留英学生。
《上海每日新闻》今日就南京近期的政治发展发表社论，对蒋介石将军能在不到40天的时间内成功结束国民党第六届中央执行委员会全体会议、国民党第五届中央执行委员会全体会议、新一届中央执行委员会第一次会议以及货币改革表示惊讶。

感受到宋的影响
该报预测，政治委员会委员宋子文将通过孔博士继续在行政中保持其影响力。
《每日新闻》总结道：“新政府的组成有利于蒋介石将军采取积极行动。如果新政府和党务机构无法克服目前的困难，注定会失败。”

（批注：登记。
请附在伊恩先生关于外交部长张群的报告后，并归档。
JAS）

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, THURSDAY, DECEMBER 12, 1935

GEN. CHANG CHUN
FOR WAICHAOPU

Romantic Career of Noted
Szechuan Patriot

Hankow, Dec. 11.
It is understood that Gen. Chang Chun, formerly Mayor of Greater Shanghai and, since 1933, chairman of the Hupeh provincial government, has definitely agreed to accept the post of Minister for Foreign Affairs in the National Government. Mr. Yang Yun-tai, Secretary to the Generalissimo, is expected to succeed him as Governor of Hupeh.
A native of Szechuan, Gen. Chang Chun, who is 47 years of age, attended the Paoting Military Academy and the Tokyo Military Staff College. While in Japan, he became affiliated with the Chinese students revolutionary party in that country and, on returning to China in 1910, in company with Gen. Chiang Kai-shek, joined Gen. Chen Chi-mei, then Military Governor of Shanghai, and was made head of the arsenal department. Gen. Chang participated in the movement against Yuan Shih-kai, serving in the artillery department. After the defeat of Chen Chi-mei, his arrest was ordered by Yuan Shih-kai, but he escaped to Japan and later went to the Netherlands East Indies. He returned to China in 1916, and became a staff officer in Chekiang, a member of the Revolutionary Government at Canton (1917-18), and a police official in Szechuan (1920).
Gen. Chang joined Feng Yu-hsiang's army in the war against Wu Pei-fu, and was made chief of the Honan provincial police (1922). Upon the defeat of the Kuominchun, he went to Kwangtung, and there joined the Northern Punitive Expedition in 1926. Following the occupation of Nanking in the spring of 1927, he was appointed chief adviser to Gen. Chiang Kai-shek, as well as a member of the Military Council of the Nationalist Government. He was made Vice-Minister of Military Affairs and concurrently director-general of the Shanghai Arsenal (1928), and was elected a member of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang in 1929. Appointed Mayor of Greater Shanghai in 1929, he held this post for two years and, in July, 1933, was made Governor of Hupeh.—Reuter.

《字林西报》，1935年12月12日，星期四

张群将军
出任外交部长

著名四川爱国者的
浪漫生涯

汉口，12月11日电。
据悉，前大上海市长、自1933年起担任湖北省政府主席的张群将军，已明确同意接受国民政府外交部长的职务。委员长秘书杨永泰先生预计将接替他担任湖北省主席。
张群将军是四川人，现年47岁，曾就读于保定陆军军官学校和东京陆军士官学校。在日本期间，他加入了那里的中国学生革命党，并于1910年回国，与蒋介石将军一同投奔时任上海都督的陈其美将军，并被任命为兵工厂部门主管。张群参与了反袁世凯运动，在炮兵部门服役。陈其美失败后，袁世凯下令逮捕他，但他逃往日本，随后前往荷属东印度群岛。他于1916年回到中国，成为浙江的一名参谋军官，广州革命政府（1917-18年）的成员，以及四川的一名警务官员（1920年）。
张群在讨伐吴佩孚的战争中加入了冯玉祥的军队，并被任命为河南省警察厅长（1922年）。国民军失败后，他前往广东，并于1926年在那里参加了北伐。1927年春南京被占领后，他被任命为蒋介石将军的首席顾问，以及国民政府军事委员会成员。1928年，他被任命为军政部次长兼上海兵工厂总监，并于1929年当选为国民党中央执行委员会委员。1929年被任命为大上海市长，任职两年，并于1933年7月被任命为湖北省主席。——路透社。

〔图片说明：张群将军〕

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Wednesday, December 11, 1935

A Japanese View
On Nanking Move

Nippo Believes ‘Clique’
Of Wang Ching-wei
Being Withdrawn

Last week’s reshuffle in the Nan-
king Government, the Shanghai
Nippo declared yesterday, meant
the withdrawal of the “clique” do-
minated by Mr. Wang Ching-wei,
President of the Executive Yuan,
from actual power.

This decline, the Nippo said, is
demonstrated by the expected re-
tirement of Mr. Wang himself, and
the replacement of Mr. Chen
Kung-po, Minister of Industry, and
Mr. Ku Meng-yu, Minister of Rail-
ways.

An Important Ministry

“The Railways Ministry in the
Nanking Government is only slight-
ly less important than the Ex-
chequer,” the paper pointed out.
“When Great Britain planned to
grant a loan to China, with rail-
way revenues as security, she could
not lay her hands on the Ministry
of Railways.

“When Mr. Wang Ching-wei re-
tires, the head of the Railways
Ministry will have to do the bid-
ding of Gen. Chiang Kai-shek.
This makes Mr. Ku Meng-yu’s re-
signation inevitable.”

Compensating Appointment

“The expected appointment of
Mr. Chang Kia-ngau as the head
of the Ministry is meant to re-
concile him for his ejection from
the Bank of China by Mr. T. V.
Soong and Dr. H. H. Kung.

“Although Mr. Chang is well
adapted for the post, he will
evidently be consoled by the ap-
pointment,” the paper continued.

The Smoke Clears

As the smoke of the Nanking
political battle clears up, the Nippo
said, it becomes increasingly ap-
parent that Gen. Chiang’s fol-
lowers have won a signal victory.
That will be seen, the paper added,
in the expected appointment of
Gen. Chang Chun as the Mini-
ster for Foreign Affairs and of
Mr. [Chang] Li-sheng as the Minister of
[Indus]try.

“Inasmuch as Gen. Chiang has
decided to assume the responsi-
bility for China’s domestic and in-
ternational policies by becoming
the actual head of the Executive
Yuan, it is only natural that his
followers are promoted to all im-
portant posts.”

“It will do well to watch his
future activities,” the paper said.

（左侧批注：）
Supt. Fan,
For about
comment please.
JAS
12 DEC. 1935

《上海晚邮报与信使报》，1935年12月11日，星期三

日本方面对
南京举动的看法

日媒认为汪精卫
“派系”正在退出

《上海日报》昨日宣称，上周南京政府的改组意味着由行政院院长汪精卫先生主导的“派系”正在退出实权舞台。

《日报》称，这种衰落体现在汪先生本人的预期离职，以及实业部长陈公博先生和铁道部长顾孟余先生的更替。

一个重要部委

该报指出：“南京政府的铁道部重要性仅略低于财政部。”“当英国计划以铁路收入为担保向中国提供贷款时，却无法掌控铁道部。”

“当汪精卫先生退休时，铁道部部长将不得不听从蒋介石将军的指挥。这使得顾孟余先生的辞职成为必然。”

补偿性任命

“预计任命张嘉璈先生为该部首长，意在安抚他因宋子文先生和孔祥熙博士将其逐出中国银行而产生的不满。”

该报继续写道：“虽然张先生很适合这个职位，但显然他将通过这一任命得到慰藉。”

烟雾散去

《日报》称，随着南京政治斗争的硝烟散去，越来越明显的是，蒋介石的追随者取得了显著胜利。该报补充说，这将体现在预计任命张群将军为外交部长和张厉生先生为实业部长上。

“既然蒋介石决定通过成为行政院的实际首脑来承担中国国内和国际政策的责任，那么他的追随者被提拔到所有重要职位也是自然的。”

该报称：“密切关注他未来的活动将是有益的。”

（左侧批注：）

请提供约
评论。
JAS
1935年12月12日
